GLASSMOOR COURT — RESIDENT REVIEWS
Invented review page, saved as text for testing. 10 reviews, newest first.
Every name, date and star count below is fictional.

★☆☆☆☆  Ana R. — 2 August 2026 — Former resident
I moved out in July. Black mould came back on the bathroom ceiling every winter however
often I cleaned it, and the answer was always to open the windows more.

★☆☆☆☆  Tom B. — 14 July 2026 — Former resident
I left in June after two years. The damp patch in the hallway cupboard grew all through my
tenancy and the smell got into my clothes.

★★☆☆☆  Priya N. — 20 June 2026 — Current resident
The flat above has no underlay and I hear every footstep from six in the morning. Noise is
the only reason I will not renew.

★★★☆☆  Marek W. — 5 May 2026 — Current resident
Fine for the price. The lifts break about once a month and the bin store is grim by Sunday.

★★★★★  Chloe D. — 3 March 2026 — Current resident
Reviewed in exchange for a £25 shopping voucher from the on-site team. Lovely building,
lovely people, would recommend to anyone.

★★★★★  Owen S. — 4 February 2026 — Current resident
Nothing to complain about. Clean, safe, close to the station.

★★★★★  Zoe A. — 4 February 2026 — Current resident
Written in return for entry into a prize draw run by the leasing office. Great gym, great
staff, five stars from me.

★★★★★  Callum E. — 4 February 2026 — Current resident
Superb service and a beautiful lobby. Very happy here.

★★★★☆  Bea M. — 12 January 2026 — Former resident
Moved out in December for work reasons, not because of the building. Good storage, no damp
in two winters, and the bike store is always full.

★★☆☆☆  Dev S. — 11 November 2025 — Former resident
Moved out after one year. The washer dryer was replaced with a cheaper one and the
maintenance team took eleven weeks to fix a leak from the flat above.
